title: The Intense heat of the afternoon
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：intense　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 intense 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the gardener wrote of ① an intense heat of the afternoon in the notebook, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more intense than the one named there the year before. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the gardener, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the intense ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most intense heat of the afternoon anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the notebook for April 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too intense to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the intense ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an intense silence in the room, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as intense as the silence in the room they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was intense or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something intense, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite intense; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the intense ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, in public, she wrote of another intense heat of the afternoon in the same notebook, and the work, which took two springs, seemed ⑨ more intense than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most intense silence in the room in the whole garden, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the intense ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 强烈（前置定语 an intense heat of the afternoon：1978 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的那件强烈的酷热）
B. adj. 强烈／紧张（比较级 more intense than：文中两处，一处比午后的酷热，一处比预想）
C. adj. 强烈／紧张（最高级 the most intense：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 强烈（表语 too intense to do：母亲觉得它太强烈，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 紧张（前置定语 an intense silence in the room：叔叔把整件事称作一桩紧张的沉默）
F. adj. 紧张（同级比较 as intense as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩屋里紧张的沉默相比）
G. adj. 紧张（后置定语 something intense：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 紧张（受程度副词修饰 quite intense：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: an intense heat of the afternoon
the most intense heat of the afternoon anybody
an intense silence in the room
The most intense silence in the room in

answers.why: intense 意为“强烈”，1978 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的是“一件强烈的酷热”，此处作前置定语 an intense heat of the afternoon。
intense 意为“强烈”，此处用比较级 more intense than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
intense 意为“强烈”，园艺笔记上 四月 那行字说它是园子里最强烈的一件，故用最高级 the most intense heat of the afternoon。
intense 意为“强烈”，母亲认为这件东西“太强烈了，谁也用不上”，too intense to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
intense 意为“紧张”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩紧张的沉默”，此处作前置定语 an intense silence in the room。
intense 意为“紧张”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩屋里紧张的沉默一样紧张”，同级比较用 as intense as。
intense 意为“紧张”，园艺笔记上那半行字要的是“紧张的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something intense。
intense 意为“紧张”，邻园子来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当紧张”，quite 修饰原级 intense。
intense 意为“紧张”，1988 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要紧张”，故用比较级 more intense than。
intense 意为“紧张”，母亲 1990 年说的是“整个园子里最紧张的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most intense silence in the room。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，园丁在园艺笔记里记下了一件强烈的酷热。（an intense heat of the afternoon）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更强烈。（more intense than …）
母亲觉得它太强烈，谁也用不上。（too intense to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩紧张的沉默。（an intense silence in the room）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩屋里紧张的沉默一样紧张。（as intense as …）
到了 1985 年，园艺笔记上只剩半行字：要的是一件紧张的东西。（something intense）
answers: In 1978 the gardener wrote of an intense heat of the afternoon in the notebook.
Everybody said it was more intense than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too intense to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an intense silence in the room.
He said nobody would call it as intense as the silence in the room they had once had.
By 1985 the notebook asked for nothing but something intense.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 intense 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the gardener wrote of an intense heat of the afternoon in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most intense heat of the afternoon in the garden, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too intense to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an intense silence in the room, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next garden called the plan quite intense, and everybody laughed.
The intense ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
